title: Minister Election
wikitext:
{{Historical|update=January 13, 2026}}
{{See also|Candidate Aura}}

The '''Minister Election''' is an election event that replaces the [[Mayor Election]] while {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}} is in office. It takes place in {{Zone|The People's Voting}}, a room that replaced the {{Zone|Election Room}}.

A player can vote on other players to become Ministers. The {{Green|7}} Ministers with the most votes will be able to add their own perks to the game: the top {{Green|3}} Ministers may create their own perks, whereas the remaining {{Green|4}} Ministers may choose from different Mayor perks and special pre-made perks.

The player cannot vote for {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}}, anyone with the {{Rank|staff}} rank, {{RankName|Pig|Technoblade}}, or blacklisted individuals like {{RankName|default|dante}}, {{RankName|MVP+|hannibal2|plus_color=5}}, or {{RankName|MVP+|Minikloon|plus_color=c}}. Ministers cannot be voted in two elections in a row, unless they use the {{AN|Long Term Investment}} perk; likewise, players who managed to reach the podium cannot be voted for in subsequent elections.

When a Minister Election concludes, the following message will display:

{{Dialogue|
&6&lATTENTION! &aThe #th Minister Election has concluded!
&eYour winners are:
&e1st: &7<playername>
&e2nd: &7<playername>
&e3rd: &7<playername>
&e4th: &7<playername>
&e5th: &7<playername>
&e6th: &7<playername>
&e7th: &7<playername>
}}

== Trivia ==
* {{RankName|MVP+|hannibal2|plus_color=5}} was blacklisted from being able to be voted for after a developer of the popular mod SkyHanni auto-filled the sign where players could vote on a minister with <code>hannibal2</code>, which counted as a chat macro: the developer behind this was also temporarily banned.
* {{RankName|YouTube|im_a_squid_kid}}, {{RankName|MVP|Confused_Goon}} and {{RankName|MVP++|SnowflakeKiwi|plus_color=9|bracket_color=b}} chose to use their perks to remove the {{AN|Minion Union}}, {{AN|Work Harder}} and {{AN|Work Smarter}} perks, respectively. As a result, they were imprisoned in the {{Zone|Prison of the Bereft}} and replaced with an {{NPCSprite|Electoral Goon}} for the duration of their term.
* {{RankName|MVP++|AscentPVP|plus_color=3}} was disqualified from the fifth election for bribing people with giveaways and invited to campaign again under the pretense that no money would be involved.
* {{RankName|YouTube|Future77}}'s '''Organ Donor''' perk is a reference to a running gag where Future77 jokes about selling his organs to afford the coins to 'hypermax' items in SkyBlock.
* While the '''Work Harder''' perk affects the {{stat|hp}} values shown in [[Bestiary]] of mobs, it doesn't change the {{stat|dmg}} value, which is also increased by the perk.
** {{NPCSprite|Derpy}}'s '''DOUBLE MOBS HP!!!''' doesn't change values in Bestiary.
** Slayer menu shows both increases to Boss's {{stat|HP}}, but omits the {{stat|Damage}}.
* After the {{Item|Precursor Drone Pet}}, {{Item|Kuudra Tentacle}}, {{Item|Blood God Sigil}}, and {{Item|Potato Ring}} were added, new items stopped being added after the conclusion of each individual Minister Election. Instead, they were slowly rolled out over time and eventually in one major update.
* {{RN|MVP+|arithemonkey}}'s perk, which was to add a 2nd [[Bingo#Secret Bingo|Secret Bingo]] to the game, was implemented on March 29th, 2026: {{Green|3}} days before the beginning of April.
* {{RN|YT|Derailious}}'s perk was originally the '''Magical Milk Mixin''', however with the implementation of {{Item|Celestial Mason Jar}} which granted the same perk, his perk was changed.
* {{RN|MVP+|Luamon}}'s perk, which was implemented as part of the [[Loadouts]] system, was first seen on the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] on June 24th, 2026.
